channel.name: 10 ORU to Lab Bundle - Mapper
channel.description: Demo oru2fhir: an ORU^R01 (POST ER7 to /oru/, port 10807) becomes a FHIR R4 transaction Bundle conforming to the example profiles in /fhir-volume/shared/lab-r4. Seven FHIR Mapper Transform steps, with no FML or mapping script. The HTTP response is the Bundle.
